messages:
maria gonzalez: Heads up — external assessors have booked a 2-hour slot next Tue for a short 'zero-day drill'. We need an RBAC change window + temporary KMS access + audit-log snapshot. Who can own? :calendar:
alex chen: I can own RBAC changes. Suggest a 1h window for role elevation and a 1h rollback window. Can we limit to a handful of service accounts?
sam patel: I can coordinate KMS access. We'll use ephemeral IAM bindings and log everything. Need the exact key resource name.
jules: tagging in runbook and incident channel, please add step for live audit export to S3 (retention 90d) — we should capture local logs + cloud audit.
kevin lee: For RBAC, propose temporary group "pen-test-temp" with these roles: `roles/iam.serviceAccountUser`, `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter`, `roles/logging.viewer`. We'll attach an expiry policy. Thoughts?
maria gonzalez: @alex and @kevin love that. Sam — can you confirm KMS org policy allows bind for that key? Also need KMS logs to include requester identity and key version.
vuln-scan-bot: scan scheduled: 2024-11-05T14:00Z -> quick results on login endpoint available after 30m.
sam patel: org policy blocks direct binds on the prod key. Workaround: create a dedicated assessment key in the 'security-ephemeral' project and rotate it after the test. I opened a request: #req-1423.
alex chen: OK creating group and IAM bindings now. Deploying with Terraform snippet:
```hcl
resource "google_project_iam_binding" "pen_test_temp" {
  project = var.project
  role    = "roles/logging.viewer"
  members = ["group:pen-test-temp@redwood.ai"]
}
```
will add kms roles similarly with expiry annotation.
jules: Make sure to document rollback commands in the runbook: `gcloud iam groups remove-members ...` + revoking key access. Also capture the audit-export run command:
```bash
gcloud logging sinks create pen-test-sink storage.googleapis.com/pen-test-logs --log-filter="resource.type=\"k8s_cluster\""
```
kevin lee: One more: we should snapshot current alerting thresholds before the drill so noisy failures don't create pager fatigue. I'll export alert rules to a gist and pin them in the thread.
maria gonzalez: Ops checklist draft: 1) create group & bindings (alex) 2) create assessment KMS key (sam) 3) create sink & run snapshot (jules) 4) schedule assessor IPs in allowlist (security-net) 5) run test 6) immediate rollback + key rotation 7) provide remediation PRs. Can folks ack? :white_check_mark:
alex chen: Ack.
sam patel: Ack, KMS key will be ready by Mon EOD.
jules: Ack — will run snapshot 10m before window.
kevin lee: Ack, exporting alerts now.
maria gonzalez: Great. After the run, please post the short intake note with findings, severity, and suggested mitigations. We'll treat as priority tickets and schedule retest within 2 weeks. If anyone hits blockers with IAM org policies, escalate to @platform-eng.
kevin lee: One question: do we want to enable more verbose audit logging during the window? extra cost but helpful.
maria gonzalez: Yes — enable DATA_WRITE + ADMIN_READ for 3 hours. Add cost note to ticket.
sam patel: Also request that the assessor only requests decrypt ops (no key creation). We'll restrict permissions accordingly.
jules: I'll update the runbook and attach the tf snippets + rollback commands. Posting in incidents channel as well.
maria gonzalez: Perfect. Closing the planning thread — I'll open a remediation-tracking thread after the drill with links to tickets. Thanks everyone :rocket:
